name: Sumer Money sdrETH repayBorrowBehalf refund reentrancy
summary: Sumer Money's CEther market sdrETH implements repayBorrowBehalf(address) by refunding any excess msg.value with a gas-forwarding msg.sender.call before it calls the nonReentrant repayBorrowBehalfInternal. During that callback the repaid ETH is already part of getCashPrior() while totalBorrows still carries the debt it settles, so exchangeRateStoredInternal() = (totalCash + totalBorrows - totalReserves) / totalSupply double-counts the same ETH. The attacker drained the market's cash with borrow(), repaid it with one wei of excess, and inside the refund callback the sdrETH exchange rate stood at 2.000000282255694646 instead of the 1.000000141462699840 the market carried a moment earlier: they redeemed their full 150 ETH deposit for half their sdrETH and, with the other half still valued at the doubled rate as Comptroller collateral, borrowed 310,000 USDC from sdrUSDC and 10.877 cbETH from sdrcbETH that were never repaid.
notes: The sdrETH proxy emitted exactly two EIP-1967 Upgraded events before the exploit: block 8981022 selecting 0x574027c70abd7b25953b2cd060ed7827fd2c7b03 at creation, and this one at block 9370330 log index 4 selecting the defective CEther implementation 0x23811c17bac40500decd5fb92d4feb972ae1e607. The proxy's implementation slot still held that artifact at block 13076768.

The two components are the exact net ERC-20 depletion of the Sumer markets in the single exploit transaction: sdrUSDC 0x142017b52c99d3dfe55e49d79df0baf7f4478c0c lost 309,999.999999 USDC and sdrcbETH 0x6345af6da3ebd9df468e37b473128fd3079c4a4b lost 10.877097943908610977 cbETH, both borrowed by 0x13d27a2d66ea33a4bc581d5fefb0b2a8defe9fe7 inside the reentrant frame and both still outstanding at block 13076770. The 150 WETH plus 645,000 USDC Balancer flash loan and the 645,000 USDC of sdrUSDC collateral were attacker-supplied and fully returned, so they are not loss; sdrETH's own ETH balance nets to zero across the transaction. The attacker sold the stolen cbETH twelve minutes later for 11.560845752555412057 WETH, which at the DefiLlama ETH price of USD 3,388.05 is USD 39,168 against the USD 39,249 marked here, so the sale did not move the cbETH market and the incident-price mark is realisable. Not counted: 74.999989365185081199 sdrETH left unredeemed at 0x13d27a2d and still held there, an unbacked residual claim on the sdrETH market rather than an extraction.
